description:
I asked Llama 3.1 8B "How many r's are in strawberry?" It said 2. This is how an LLM writes, one token at a time, and why its dice landed on 2.

It answered "There are 2 r's in the word 'strawberry'." At the deciding token the odds were 2 (69.7%) and 3 (30.3%). Everything it did is on screen: the tokens it read, every attention head, the feed-forward activations, the odds at every step. Every number comes from that run (RTX 3090, bf16, temperature 0.6, top-p 0.9, seed 7) or is computed from it and labelled.

{chapters}

Made with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5): lyrics, the song (ACE-Step 1.5), word alignment, every scene (three.js), the render. Renderer forked from mexicat's p(doom) video (MIT).
